name: mcp-absolute-path-config
description: Fix MCP server 'Executable not found' errors by using absolute paths in .mcp.json. Trigger when: (1) Claude Code can't find MCP server executable, (2) 'Executable not found in $PATH' error, (3) setting up .mcp.json for conda/venv projects, (4) MCP config with kintsugi init or kintsugi mcp config.
